When Does the NFL Thanksgiving Day Game 2026 Start ?

The NFL Thanksgiving Day Game happens on Thursday (Nov. 26) with a matchup featuring the Chicago Bears (7-2) taking on the Detroit Lions (7-2) at Ford Field in Detroit, Michigan, with a start time of 1 p.m. ET/10 a.m. PT.

What TV Network Features the NFL Thanksgiving Day Game 2026?

The Bears-Lions game broadcasts on CBS, while the NFL game is available to livestream on Paramount+ .

Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances During the NFL Thanksgiving Day Game 2026?

NFL games are known for celebrity sightings, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance. Artists have been known to appear at games in the past, include Lions fans Eminem (who is producing the halftime show), Jack White, Sam Richardson, Tim Robinson, Keegan-Michael Key and others.

Additionally, Wu-Tang Clan performs at halftime, which starts around 2:30 p.m. ET/11:30 a.m. PT.

Plus, Broadway singer Antonio Cipriano is set to perform the National Anthem, “The Star-Spangled Banner.”
